summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened primary XML/PDF, OA package, supplement PDF text, and linked database rows; Table 2 MICs, supplement Table S3 sequence/prediction records, and Myticalin A5 mechanism evidence are source-reviewed with nonblocking cautions.
adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review reopened primary XML/PDF, OA package, supplement PDF text, and linked database rows; Table 2 MICs, supplement Table S3 sequence/prediction records, and Myticalin A5 mechanism evidence are source-reviewed with nonblocking cautions.

notes: Primary XML/PDF contain Table 1, Table 2, method sections, Figure 6 caption, and the A5 mechanism discussion used for adjudication.
OA packages were reopened and contain the same XML/PDF/figures plus the supplement PDF.
Supplement PDF text was recovered with pdftotext and supplies Table S1-S3; supplementary_tables.json remains empty because the framework table extractor did not structure the PDF table.
Linked database JSONL snapshots were reopened and reconciled row-by-row against Table 2, XML article metadata, XML Table 1, and supplement Table S3.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 155 linked database/literature rows were reopened. The prior Acinetobacter conflicts are resolved as a primary-table spelling variant with matching MIC values; sequence-only prediction rows are tied to supplement Table S3 and not promoted to experimental MIC evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows now enumerate all 42 Table 2 peptide-by-strain MIC cells with peptide entity, target, raw value, unit, assay method context, and XML locator. No local toxicity/hemolysis table exists, so no toxicity values are fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are bounded: MIC is phenotype-only, ribosomal translation inhibition is guarded as negative/weak evidence, and the direct mechanism claim is limited to A5 inhibition of T7 RNA polymerase-mediated transcription in vitro.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: The owner-layer rework ticket is closed because source-reviewed artifacts replace the framework-only scaffold and no blocking or major open issue remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary Table 2 has a spelling variant in the A. baumannii row; methods text and database rows support Acinetobacter baumannii ATCC 19606, and MIC values match.
supplementary_tables.json contains no structured tables, but pdftotext over the local supplement PDF recovered Table S1-S3 sufficiently for worker-4/6 adjudication.
Database rows for non-Table-2 myticalins are verified only as source-supported sequence/in-silico prediction records from supplement Table S3, not as experimental MIC claims.
A5 mechanism support is in vitro T7 RNA polymerase transcription inhibition; ribosomal inhibition and antiviral activity are not accepted as demonstrated mechanisms.
